Certification of products: Determination of the product type (an assessment of performance), initial inspection of the manufacturing plant and of factory production control, continuing surveillance, assessment and evaluation of factory production control, audit-testing of samples taken at the manufacturing plant or at the manufacturing storage facilities system (1+): Cement, Steel.

Certification of process: Initial inspection of factory production control (FPC) system, countinious surveillance, assessment and evaluation of factory production control (FPC) system (2+): Concrete, Masonry mortar, Products and systems for the protection and repair of concrete structures, Bituminous mixtures, Aggregates, Admixtures for concrete, hydraulic road binders
